perf(fiat): index restricted resources by group and use sets for service account role checks (#8136)
Every role sync resolves permissions for every user, and each resolution
scanned every cached resource: BaseResourceProvider.getAllRestricted
filtered all accounts and applications per user and, for each restricted
one, called Permissions.isAuthorized, which builds a Role per permission

role names. The snapshot is cached as a single value so the index can
never disagree with the resources it was built from. loadAll(), getAll()

perf(sql): avoid loading the full execution for foreign partition checks (#8135)
storeStage and delete only need the execution's partition to decide whether
it is foreign, but went through doForeignAware, which loads the full
execution and every stage body. storeStage is called for every stage update,
so this added a large read to one of the hottest write paths.

- Add doForeignAwareByPartition, which selects only the partition column,
  and use it for storeStage and delete.
- Only serialize the stage for a PatchStageInterlinkEvent when the event is
  actually published.
- Add sql.enforceForeignPartition (default true). When interlink is disabled
  and this is false, storeStage and delete skip the partition lookup
  entirely. Operations that store the whole execution still reject foreign
  executions.

[Python] Reuse Milvus client in RAG vector sink write path (#39378)
* Reuse Milvus client in vector sink write path

_MilvusSink.write() constructed a new MilvusClient on every call, which
discarded the retry-wrapped client created in __enter__. This bypassed the
connection retry/backoff and left the initial client unclosed (leaked),
while __exit__ only closed the last client. The write() docstring also
incorrectly claimed the collection was flushed for durability.

Reuse the client established in __enter__ for the upsert, and correct the
docstring to describe the actual (no-flush) visibility semantics. Add a
unit test asserting write() reuses the __enter__ client instead of
reconstructing one per call.

checks during routine node churn.

[ML] Log renormalization search-context loss at WARN instead of ERROR (#155803)
Anomaly detection renormalization scrolls over results via
BatchedDocumentsIterator. When the scroll context is lost - for example
because a node holding it leaves the cluster during a rolling restart, or
because the context expires - the search fails and

* [core] Fix OAS 3.1 typed map misclassified as free-form object (#25224)

OpenAPI 3.1 JsonSchema additionalProperties with a typed value were treated as free-form objects, causing C# generichost map responses to emit Model.Dictionary instead of Dictionary<string, T>.

Evaluate additionalProperties with getType() and exclude composed or property-bearing value schemas from isFreeFormObject.

Fixes #25224

* [core] Do not treat enum-only map values as free-form objects

OAS 3.1 value schemas can constrain values with enum and omit type. isFreeFormObject treated that missing type as unconstrained.

fix(csharp): use numeric JSON operations for numeric enum converters (#22917)
* fix(csharp): use numeric JSON operations for integer enum converters in C# generichost

Integer enums now correctly use reader.GetInt32()/GetInt64() and
writer.WriteNumberValue() instead of reader.GetString() and
writer.WriteStringValue() in the generated JsonConverter classes.

This fixes System.InvalidOperationException when deserializing integer
enum values from JSON numbers.

* fix: handle double/float/decimal enums correctly in JSON converters

For floating-point enums (double, float, decimal), C# enums can't have
non-integral underlying types, so:
- ToJsonValue now returns actual enum values via switch-case instead of
  casting (which gave wrong values like 2.0 instead of -1.2)
- Read method uses reader.GetDouble() etc. and converts to string with
  InvariantCulture for matching via FromStringOrDefault

member matching so model property defaults still resolve correctly.
